title: An all-time favorite
body: I absolutely love the GR Watermelon Dew Drops. They have been a staple in my skin care routine for years now. The formulation is top notch, the scent is lovely and not overpowering, it's not too thick or too runny so applying is it very easy.  The instant soothing and glow that I get whenever using right before moisturizer can't be beat.  The hydration I get from using the Dew Drops as a primer makes my foundations sit beautifully on my skin. For most of my life, I had to use matte foundation because I was so oily but as my skin has matured, dry spots started forming. That's when I tried using them as a primer and lucky for me,  it worked so well that I didn't have to replace every one of my matte foundations because i don't have to worry about things looking cakey. Because of the multiple ways this can be used, I definitely recommend trying the Dew Drops out if you haven't already and I plan to keep using them for the foreseeable future (along with all of my other GR products)!
skin_concern: Dryness, Anti-aging, Pores, Dark spots, Oiliness

title: Back to the basics!
body: Dew Drops were one of the first Glow Recipe products I tried, and honestly I'd forgotten how amazing they are! I favor a natural makeup look, so it's perfect for mixing with foundation for an effortless, dewy, perfectly blended result. The fresh watermelon smell is great too!

body: I’m pleasantly surprised. I was afraid it may feel oily but it adds the right amount of extra moisture. When I wear makeup over it, I’m impressed how my skin is still glowing and smooth.

title: The OG dew drops are amazing!
body: I absolutely love the Watermelon Dew Drops. It is so light and refreshing and gives my face such a nice glow. It absorbs really nicely and works well under makeup. Sometimes I’ll use this as a light moisturizer, but I typically use this under my banana soufflé cream. I notice that my skin looks brighter when I use this. title: I always go back to this product!

title: My favorite serum!!!!
body:
I have been using this product for just over 4 years, and the experience is always so enjoyable. I apply it twice a day, between toner and moisturizer. It goes on really smooth and evenly and immediately starts to soothe my dryness/irritation. It also makes my moisturizer go on way more smoothly compared to when I don't use it. It has really helped calm my skin's constant irritation significantly since I started using it, and I have learned not to let myself run out, because my skin issues consistently come back with a vengeance when I do. It visibly evens out my skin tone and hyperpigmentation, calms the redness, and my pores are significantly less noticeable
This product, especially in combination with the rest of my glow recipe routine, has proven to me that it is actually possible to not feel like my skin is constantly screaming from dryness and irritation so loudly that I can't focus on anything else, and I never want to go back

But I’ve found that they are also great to use all on their own for a quick boost of immediate hydration and added glow anytime my skin is feeling a bit dry! I like to have a mini Dew Drops with me at all times for quick skincare touch ups! Definitely recommend!

Highly recommend if you’re looking for soft, glowing skin!

title: Minimalist Must Have

My skin drinks it up yet it never feels heavy. Make up does not pill layered on top of Dew Drops and it does not cling to my pores or texture. It leaves a healthy glow to your skin that looks lit from within and not greasy. I love using these drops especially during the summer months when my skin needs to breathe yet I want that summer glow!!!

Paired with the Watermelon Toner and a Glow Recipe moisturizer, my skin stays soft, smooth, and glowing all day. I wear minimal makeup and love adding Dewy Flush and, occasionally, Hue Drops for an extra glow. Even a couple of years later, my skin looks just as youthful—if not more so. Thank you, Glow Recipe, for helping me maintain healthy, glowing skin! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

title: Extremely Versatile Glow
body: I’ve tried using the dew drops at basically every stage of my skincare - and as part of my makeup base layer. It’s incredibly versatile! My favorite is as a serum in the morning, after cleansing but before moisturizer (plum). When it’s hot out and I don’t want a thick moisturizer, I just use the dew drops before sunscreen. Zero pilling. I tried mixing it with both my lightweight and moderate-coverage foundations from a different brand and there was still no pilling! It amped up my base, making my skin look even more hydrated - and I think it helped the foundation last longer. I have very fair, very dry skin. And this will have a permanent place in my bathroom (and makeup bag).

title: The Perfect Everyday Glow
body: I've really enjoyed adding these Dew Drops to my routine. They give my skin a beautiful, natural glow without looking shiny or greasy, and the lightweight formula leaves my skin feeling hydrated and smooth. I especially love using them during the day to brighten my complexion, and I also apply an extra layer before bed when my skin needs a boost of overnight hydration. They're incredibly versatile and have become an easy staple in my skincare routine.

body: This is one of the OG Glow Recipe products and lives up to the name. It is a lightly watermelon scented gel that goes on super smooth like velvet. I usually use it at night because it makes my skin feel a little sticky afterward. It definitely makes your skin look all glowy and dewy though.
skin_concern: Dark spots, Uneven tone, Oiliness, Pores

title: Sensitive skin friendly, but not for me
body:
I took a chance and added this in right after recovering from a compromised barrier, and as a testiment to its formula the Niacinamide Dew Drops didn't irritate my sensitive skin in any way, but otherwise I find it uneccesary for my routine. I don't wear makeup and the "glass-skin" trend isn't really my scene, and I don't hold enough interest to see how its pore and oil minimizing effects would hold long term.

However for those that do like those things, it didn't set off my skin for the five days I used it, either with breakouts or rosacea flares, and the scent is very mild.

title: The GOAT
body: This is my absolute favorite GR product. I love mixing this with my foundation, it helps give a nice dewy look without interfering with the color and keeps my foundation from getting cakey. Its also great when I don't feel like putting on makeup at all, but my skin needs a little pick me up.

title: Lovely way to layer under sunscreen
body: I have been using this product for YEARS and it has enhanced my makeup days and no makeup days! I love to layer it under my sunscreen for a effortless dewy look

title: Must Have Product
body: While Glow Recipe did recently send me a sample for free I I've been using the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops every single day for years, and they've truly earned a permanent spot in my routine. The sweet watermelon scent is so enjoyable without being overwhelming, and the formula feels lightweight, hydrating, and comfortable on my skin. My foundation always applies more smoothly after using these, and I love the fresh, dewy finish they give. This is one of those tried-and-true products I never want to be without and will continue repurchasing.

title: Must have item!!

This product is truly amazing and I highly recommend!!!!

title: A Staple in my Routine
body: I have used this product for years. It smells amazing and absorbs quickly into my skin. It gives my skin a great glow without looking greasy. It also helps my foundation perform better. I adore this product!

title: A Shiny Summer Skin Solution
body: I initially bought Dew Drops to replace my powder highlighter. It does a good job as a highlighter, with a very natural look. I also really like it mixed into my moisturizer. In the summer, I like a light layer of the oil-free watermelon moisturizer, and then I mix a pump of Dew Drops into a second layer. It helps keep my skin from dehydrating in the dry air without making me break out, and it looks nice without a layer of foundation.  Over time, it's made my skin a lot brighter and smoother.

title: Watermelon Dew Drops
body: I love the Watermelon Dew Drops as part of my skincare routine. Very pleasant texture and smell. Leaves my skin with a nice dewy look.

title: Best Addition to My Skincare Routine!
body: I love this product so much.  I use it after the Watermelon Toner to make my skin glow.   It is so versatile.  I can use it under my makeup or at night.  My skin feels so soft and smooth.  I love how well it works with other Glow Recipe serums and moisturizers.   Since finding Glow Recipe almost a year ago, I have never been happier with my skin.

title: Glow like no other
body: I’m obsessed with these Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops! A few drops give my skin the most beautiful, juicy dewiness without looking greasy. It hydrates instantly and makes my complexion look brighter and more even after a couple weeks. The texture is silky and lightweight—perfect as a serum, primer, or highlight. The subtle watermelon scent is a bonus. My new everyday essential for that fresh, glass-skin vibe. Highly recommend!

title: Must have for my daily routine and travel kit
body: I’m obsessed with  all things Glow Recipe but this is definitely in my top three! This product is so lightweight and makes my skin feel so supple and youthful. The scent is also amazing. It’s a must have for travel and my daily routine. I use this after the Watermelon Toner and add it to the Watermelon moisturizer to get a glowy, dewy look each morning. It goes on smoothly and isn’t sticky. And throughout the day is lightweight. Most importantly, my skin is prone to breakouts and this does not clog pores. I’ve been using it for about 2 years consistently and my skin is the best it has been.

title: Affordable and Effective!
body: Dew Drops are a consistent tool in my skincare routine. I have combination skin and it can be challenging to find products that work over multiple seasons/weather challenges. Dew drops are lightweight and do not leave an uncomfortable stickiness on the skin, which is a huge bonus. I do not regularly wear makeup and can’t comment on how Dew Drops may assist, but I love how they assist with skin brightness and smoothing out my pores. There is a mild watermelon fragrance but that component does not irritate my skin or linger.

title: So fresh and so clean
body:
I use these as my last serum before the Watermelon moisturizer. My skin feels smooth and lush, without the stickiness.

I only use eyeliner and mascara and found that applying eyeliner was smoother which helped me get cleaner, finer lines. I realized that throughout the day, my makeup looked like I’d just applied it.

I also noticed that my pores appeared smaller with an overall smoothness to my face. So fresh, so clean.

title: 🩷Dew Drops 🩷
body: I love that dew drops can be used by anyone - dry skin, oily skin, and everything in-between! I use it morning and night, immediately after toning. It makes my skin feel soft, supple, and gently moisturized. It layers well under sunscreen and my makeup looks flawless. Over time, I've noticed my skin is smoother and more “calm.” I really enjoy this product and recommend to anyone looking for a versatile product they can easily incorporate into their skincare routine.

title: Excellent product!
body: This is the product that introduced me to GR years ago. It has transformed my 40+ year old skin. I was able to use it while pregnant and nursing. It keeps my skin looking young and fresh and I don’t need to go around wearing foundation!

title: My go to <3

The watermelon dew drops absorb easily into my skin and doesn't leave my skin feeling sticky. Overall, my skin looks a lot brighter and clearer.

title: Skin Glass Look
body: These drops make your face look so dewy making your skin have a glass look. Definitely recommend for skin on the drier side! If you have more oily skin it may make your face look more shiny so I recommend doing less drops to not have that result. Love that there’s niacinamide in this to help with my dark spots.

title: Dewy for dayyssss
body: I absolutely love the subtle dewyness this serum gives me!! I sometimes use it just under mosturizer, or mix it with my tinted spf for a dewy finish! It’s on my face daily and I don’t see that changing anytime soon.

title: Best addition to routine! 🍉
body: I’ve been using The Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops for a year already. Is a delightful addition to my skincare routine! To incorporate this product, I recommend using it after cleansing and toning your skin. Apply a few drops to your fingertips and gently press it into your face and neck, allowing it to absorb fully. You can use it as a serum under your moisturizer for added hydration, or mix it with your foundation for a beautiful, dewy finish. It works wonderfully both in the morning and  at night I highly recommend the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide for anyone looking to add hydration and radiance to their skincare! It’s truly the best!! 🍉🩷

title: Part of My Nightly Routine
body: I really like this version of the dew drops. I typically use the tinted ones as my make up routine, but I use this version when I’m not wearing makeup and when I want to use something at night. It’s very light and it absorbs quickly into the skin. It doesn’t leave any sort of residue or grease.

title: Love it
body: I love how well this works with my makeup and skincare routines. I have been using this for more than four years now and I have seen a huge difference in my skin. My skin has gotten more radiant, plumper, clearer! I have backups of this serum it is that good.

title: Glassy and Clear Skin!
body:
This was the first serum I used that showed me what a remarkable difference niacinamide can make for my skin. I had severe cystic acne through my teens and 20s and am still prone to the odd breakout, and this is a product that has truly and significantly improved my skin’s texture. When I use this it looks glassy and dewy, both hydrated and clear! Although there are a number of other less expensive niacinamide serums and products that I do also enjoy using, I continue to keep this one in rotation as well because the formula is so special and it has so many great actives that benefit the skin. 

Although I have purchased this product for myself numerous times, Glow Recipe did send me some this time in exchange for honest review.
skin_concern: Dryness, Dullness, Anti-aging, Acne, Uneven tone

title: Excellent serum
body: I love Glow Recipe.   My skin is very sensitive and I have never had a problem with any Glow Recipe product.   I tried the Glow Recipe Watermelon Glow Niacinamide Dew Drops.  The serum is thicker than I expected.   When I put it on my face, my skin felt so good.  It was also very hydrated and glowing.   I use it day and night before I use a moisturizer.

title: Staple for a Reason
body: A best seller for a reason.  This serum hydrates my skin and makes it look dewy and healthy.  Works well under makeup; I use it as a base underneath my tinted moisturizer as a way to add extra glow into my makeup routine.  Love the smell and a little goes a long way.  I received a sample from Glow Recipe for this review.

title: Essential!
body: Dew Drops are a staple and essential part of my skincare routine. Even with my most basic skincare routines, this is one I don't miss. It feels great and moisturizing on its own. I've used it alone, or after mist and toner and then apply moisturizer afterward.

title: Natural Glow
body: I love these drop! They give such a hydrated yet subtle glow.  I use it under my makeup to provide a dewy yet greaseless look, before my sunscreen and on my no makeup days to give me that glass skin look. Definitely a must try and must have addition!
